abstract: OBJECTIVE: To study whether there is any relationship between a serum tumor markers panel (CA19-9, CA 125, CEA, CA15-3 and AFP) and the tumor size in patients with ovarian dermoid cyst in reproductive age. BACKGROUND: Between January 2006-2007, 160 patients were operated in the Department of Infertility, Zekai Tahir Burak Women Health Hospital due to ovarian dermoid cyst. METHODS: The clinical data and serum tumor markers levels of operated patients were retrieved from the records of the department. This was a retrospective study. RESULTS: Forty-four patients (37.6 %) had high levels of CA 19-9 , twenty-seven patients (19.3 %) had high CA 125 levels, eleven patients (9.4 %) had high levels of CEA, five patients (4 %) had high levels of CA 15-3 and one patient (0.9 %) had high AFP levels at the time of initial surgery. The bilaterality rate was 8.1 %. When grouping the tumor size as 10 cm, the mean serum levels of tumor markers had significantly increased by increasing the tumor size (p<0.05) for CA 19-9, CA 125, CEA. CONCLUSIONS: Our study suggests that serum CA 19-9 is probably more accurate marker than other tumor markers in the ovarian dermoid cysts. Also, the most important parameter that affects CA 19-9 elevation in the dermoid cysts, is the tumor size. As the tumor becomes bigger, this relationship becomes more distinct (Tab. 2, Ref. 15).
abstract_ja: 目的：生殖年齢の卵巣類皮嚢腫患者において、血清腫瘍マーカーパネル（CA19-9、CA125、CEA、CA15-3、AFP）と腫瘍径との関連を検討すること。背景：2006年1月〜2007年に、Zekai Tahir Burak Women Health Hospitalの不妊科で160例が卵巣類皮嚢腫のため手術を受けた。方法：手術を受けた患者の臨床データと血清腫瘍マーカー値を施設の記録から抽出した。本研究は後方視的研究である。結果：初回手術時に、44例（37.6%）でCA 19-9が高値、27例（19.3%）でCA 125が高値、11例（9.4%）でCEAが高値、5例（4%）でCA 15-3が高値、1例（0.9%）でAFPが高値であった。両側性の割合は8.1%であった。腫瘍径を10 cmで区分したところ、腫瘍径の増加に伴い、CA 19-9、CA 125、CEAの血清腫瘍マーカー平均値が有意に上昇した（p<0.05）。結論：本研究は、卵巣類皮嚢腫においては血清CA 19-9が他の腫瘍マーカーより正確なマーカーである可能性を示唆する。また、類皮嚢腫におけるCA 19-9上昇に最も影響するパラメータは腫瘍径である。腫瘍径が大きくなるほど、この関連はより明確になる。（Tab. 2, Ref. 15）
